label: Bible Study
prompt: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come _____. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
verse: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
note: The Bible's last promise — and the next-to-last verse in the whole book.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Yet I will _____ in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
verse: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
note: No figs, no fruit, no flocks in the verse before — and still Habakkuk says 'Yet I will rejoice.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the men of David said unto him, Behold the day of which the LORD said unto thee, Behold, I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand, that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee. Then David arose, and cut off the _____ of Saul's robe privily.
verse: And the men of David said unto him, Behold the day of which the LORD said unto thee, Behold, I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand, that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee. Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul's robe privily.
note: David could have killed Saul in the cave; instead he cut off the 'skirt' of the king's robe — and still felt guilty.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Say unto them, As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I have no _____ in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
verse: Say unto them, As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
note: God swears by his own life that he wants the wicked to turn and live — then pleads, 'turn ye, turn ye.'

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For thus saith the high and lofty One that _____ eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
verse: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
note: The God 'that inhabiteth eternity' also dwells with the contrite and humble — the highest address and the lowest.
